coverage: Selected official generic server scenarios for the 2025-era protocol. Not a complete suite, certification, or 2026 protocol validation.
exclusions: tools-call-* require the official example tool fixtures; the application does not publish those tools.
Resource-read and prompt-get fixture scenarios expect example URIs/names. Application-specific paths remain covered by our process smoke tests.
Sessions, subscriptions, sampling, elicitation, OAuth, and other optional capability scenarios are outside this stateless read-only application profile.
